paite: "Huai hun chiang in kei Israel inkuante Pathian ka hi ding a, amaute leng ka mite ahi ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
heading: Israel Tunding Nawnna
english: At that time, says Yahweh, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Namsau thah valte, gamdai gam a ka khawl tawldamsak lai in hehpihna amu ua, Israel mahmah ka tawldamsak lai in.
english: Thus says Yahweh, The people who were left of the sword found favor in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.

paite: Nidang a ka kiang a TOUPA hong kilang in, hichi in achi: Ahi, it tawp lou in ka hon it a, huaiziak in lainatna in ka hon kai hi.
english: Yahweh appeared of old to me, saying, Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love: therefore with loving kindness have I drawn you.

paite: K'on dingh thaksak ding, nungak siangthou Israel aw, dingh in kipsak na hong hi ding a, na khuangte toh kizem in na om nawn ding a, nopsak lai lamna munte ah na tel ding hi.
english: Again will I build you, and you shall be built, O virgin of Israel: again you shall be adorned with your tambourines, and shall go forth in the dances of those who make merry.

paite: Samaria tang dung tawn in grephuante na bawl ding a, teng mite'n aching ding ua, agahte ane ding uhi.
english: Again you shall plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria; the planters shall plant, and shall enjoy its fruit.

paite: Ephraim tanggamte ah, ching mite kikou ni atung ding hi. Thou un, Zion ah i hoh ding uh, TOUPA i Pathian uh kiang ah," chi in.
english: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen on the hills of Ephraim shall cry, Arise, and let us go up to Zion to Yahweh our God.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Jakob a ding in nuam in la sa unla, nam thupipen a ding in kikoukhia un, puang unla, pahtawi unla, "TOUPA Israel khosuaksun, na mite hondam in,' chi un.
english: For thus says Yahweh, Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout for the chief of the nations: publish, praise, and say, Yahweh, save your people, the remnant of Israel.

paite: Ngai un, mal gam a kipan ka hon pi ding, kawlmong tawp a kipan ka kaikhawm ding, mittaw, khebai, numei naupaite, nauvei lelte toh, mipi tampitak ahong tungkhawm ding uh.
english: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the uttermost parts of the earth, along with the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her who travails with child together: a great company shall they return here.

paite: Khitui toh ahong pai ding ua, khamuangtak in ka pi ding, tui luang lamte ah ka vaksak ding a, akisuihlouhna ding uh lamtangte ah; Israel a ding in pa ka hi a, Ephraim bel ka tachil ahi.
english: They shall come with weeping; and with petitions will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by rivers of waters, in a straight way in which they shall not stumble; for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.

paite: Aw namte aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia unla, tui gei gam gamlapi ah puang unla, Israel dalhsakpa'n apikhawm nawn ding a, Belamchingpa'n abelamte akep bang in akem ding chi in.
english: Hear the word of Yahweh, you nations, and declare it in the islands afar off; and say, He who scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as shepherd does his flock.

paite: Jakob bel TOUPA'N atankhia a, asang a hat a pan ahunkheta hi.
english: For Yahweh has ransomed Jacob, and redeemed him from the hand of him who was stronger than he.

paite: Zion vum ah lasa in ahong pai ding ua, TOUPA hoihna ah akipak ding ua, buhte, uainte, thaute, belam leh ganhon noute tungte ah akipak ding uh; ahinna uh tui avak huan bang ahi ding a, tangtawn in alungkham nawn kei ding uh.
english: They shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow to the goodness of Yahweh, to the grain, and to the new wine, and to the oil, and to the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.

paite: Huan nungak siangthoute kipak a lam in anuam ding ua, tangvalte leng atek-akhang in anuam ding ua, alusuunna uh kipahna ka suaksak in ka khamuan ding, adahna ua pan ka kipaksak ding.
english: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, and the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.

paite: Siampute hinna thau in ka taisak ding a, ka hoihna in ka mite leng atai ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ramah ah husa aza ua, misi ngai a kap huphup, Rakil in atate akah a, atate a-om nawn louh ziak in akhamuan theih kei hi.
heading: Israel Tung A TOUPA Lainatna
english: Thus says Yahweh: A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children; she refuses to be comforted for her children, because they are no more.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Kap lou ding in na aw dek inla, na khitui hul hen, na thilhih in kipahman anei ding chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Gal gam a kipan in ahong pai nawn ding uhi.
english: Thus says Yahweh: Refrain your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears; for your work shall be rewarded, says Yahweh; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.

paite: Na hun tawp lam a ding in lametna a-om a, amau gam ah na tate ahong kik nawn ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: There is hope for your latter end, says Yahweh; and your children shall come again to their own border.

paite: Ephraim kah leh mauna ka za hi, nang na hon gawt a, bawngtaltuai sawi bang mai in sawi ka hi a, na kiang ah hon kiksak inla, ka kik ding hi, TOUPA ka Pathian na hi ngal a.
english: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus, You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf: turn me, and I shall be turned; for you are Yahweh my God.

paite: N'on kiksak khit nung in ka kisika, na hon thuzoh nung in ka pheipi ka beng a, ka zum a, ahi, ka tuailai minsiat thuak in ka am ahai hi,” achi hi.
english: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I struck on my thigh: I was ashamed, yes, even confounded, because I bore the reproach of my youth.

paite: Ephraim, ka tapa deihtak, ka nau deihtak ahih ziak hia amah ka thunun teng a ka lungtang a aten tinten nak? Huchi in ka lungtang in amah alainat sek a, atung ah zah ka ngai ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a darling child? for as often as I speak against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my heart yearns for him; I will surely have mercy on him, says Yahweh.

paite: Lampi chiamtehna kibawl inla, nang a ding in lampi kawkmuhna phut in, na va pawtna lam lampi, lampi pen lam ngei chiamteh tinten in; aw nungak siangthou Israel, hong kik nawn in, na khopi ngei ah.
english: Set up road signs, make guideposts; set your heart toward the highway, even the way by which you went: turn again, virgin of Israel, turn again to these your cities.

paite: Aw, nang tanu nungtawn, bang tan ahia na vialvak vak ding? TOUPA'N lei ah thil thak asiamta a, numei in pasal ahum zawta hi.
english: How long will you go here and there, you backsliding daughter? for Yahweh has created a new thing in the earth: a woman shall encompass a man.

paite: Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Asaltanna ua kipan ka pikik hun chiang in Judah gam leh akhopite ah hichibang paukam azang nawn ding uh; "Aw, diktatna tenna mun, Aw tang siangthou, TOUPA'N hon vualzawl hen," chih.
heading: Hun Hong Tung Ding A Israel Lohchinna
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, Yet again shall they use this speech in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I shall bring again their captivity: Yahweh bless you, habitation of righteousness, mountain of holiness.

paite: Huai ah Judahte leh akhopi uah mi tengteng atengkhawm ding ua, lounei mite leh ganvul mite toh.
english: Judah and all its cities shall dwell therein together, the farmers, and those who go about with flocks.

paite: Mibahte ka taisakta a, milungkham peuhmahte leng ka hihhalhta hi.
english: For I have satiated the weary soul, and every sorrowful soul have I replenished.

paite: Huchi in ka hong halh a, ka nga vialvial a, mang hoihtak ana hi.
english: On this I awakened, and saw; and my sleep was sweet to me.

paite: Ngai dih, nite ahong tung ding hi, Israel inkote leh Judah inkote ah mihing chi leh gan chi ka tuh ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of animal.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, amau botkhia a, hihzan leh paikhia a, hihmang a, hihgim ding a ka tan bang in amau ding hoihsak ding leh tungding ding in ka enkhe nawn ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: It shall happen that, like as I have watched over them to pluck up and to break down and to overthrow and to destroy and to afflict, so will I watch over them to build and to plant, says Yahweh.

paite: Huai nite in, "Pate'n grep thuk ane ua, atate uh ha azau a, achi nawn ngei kei ding uh."
english: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.

paite: Michih in amau gitlouhna asihpih zaw ding ua, grep thuk ne peuhmah ha azau ding hi.
english: But everyone shall die for his own iniquity: every man who eats the sour grapes, his teeth shall be set on edge.

paite: Ngai dih, nite ahong tung ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; huai nite ah Israel inkote leh Judah inkote kiang ah thukhun thak ka bawl ding.
english: Behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:

paite: Apipute uh Aigupta gam a kipan a pikhe ding a akhut uh ka let ni a ka thukhun bang hilou in, amaute a dia apasal uh ka hih in leng ka thukhun abohsia ua, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they broke, although I was a husband to them, says Yahweh.

paite: Huai ni khit chiang a Israel inkote kiang a ka thukhun ding bel hiai ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; asunggil uah ka dan ka koih ding a, alungtang uah ka gelh lai ding a, kei a Pathian uh ka hi ding a, amau ka mite ahi ding uh;
english: But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says Yahweh: I will put my law in their inward parts, and in their heart will I write it; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people:

paite: Kuamah in, "TOUPA thei in, chi in amau invengte leh amau unau ahilh kei ding ua; aneupen a kipan in alianpen tan in avek un ahon thei chiat ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, "Abohsiatna uh ka ngaidam ding a, akhelhna uh leng ka theigige kei ding," chi in.
english: and they shall teach no more every man his neighbor, and every man his brother, saying, Know Yahweh; for they shall all know me, from their least to their greatest, says Yahweh: for I will forgive their iniquity, and their sin will I remember no more.

paite: Hichi in TOUPA, sun vaksak ding a ni pepa, kha leh aksite a dia dante sehsak a, zan vaksak ding a pepa, tuikihotte ging honhon ding a tuipi tokthoupa'n achi hi; amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
english: Thus says Yahweh, who gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, who stirs up the sea, so that its waves roar; Yahweh of Armies is his name:

paite: "Hiai dansehte ka ma a kipan amanleh Israel suante ka ma a kipan in nam hih atawp den sam ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: If these ordinances depart from before me, says Yahweh, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me forever.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Tunglam van teh theih ahih a, lei kingaknate zonkhiak theih ahihleh Israel suante athilhihsate uh ziak in ka paimang sam ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Thus says Yahweh: If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, then will I also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, says Yahweh.

paite: "Ngai in, nite ahong tung lellel hi, Hananel insung a kipan in kulh ning kongpi tan in TOUPA a ding in khopi lamkhiak ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that the city shall be built to Yahweh from the tower of Hananel to the gate of the corner.

paite: Atehna khau bel Gareb mual tan in tangtak in apai zinzen ding a, Goath lam ah akawi ding hi.
english: The measuring line shall go out further straight onward to the hill Gareb, and shall turn about to Goah.

paite: Misi luang leh vut paihna phaizang pumpi leh gamlak tengteng, Kidron lui phaizang tan in, suahlam pang Sakol Kongpi ning tan TOUPA ding a tan ding ahi; huai tuh chikchiang mah a hihzak leh phelsiat ahi nawn kei ding hi."
english: The whole valley of the dead bodies and of the ashes, and all the fields to the brook Kidron, to the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy to Yahweh; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more forever.
